name: Heated and pipe-in-pipe flowlines
principle: An insulated inner pipe inside an outer carrier pipe, optionally with electrical trace heating, keeps hot well fluids above hydrate and wax temperatures over long tiebacks. A Gulf of Mexico case shows pipe-in-pipe flowlines being used to limit heat loss and hot-oil circulation for remediation.
